HDDS-2688.title: Refactor container response builders to hdds-common
HDDS-2688.description: {{ContainerUtils}} and {{BlockUtils}} have some helper functions to build responses to container commands.  These would be useful for client-side unit tests, but {{client}} does not depend on {{container-service}} since the interfaces and messages it needs are defined in {{common}}.  This issue proposes to move these helpers to {{common}} to avoid duplicating the functionality for tests.

HDDS-2815.title: Fix shell description for --start parameter of listing buckets
HDDS-2815.description:
In master-branch, the listing bucket show the description 
 *--start=<startBucket> The first bucket to start the listing*

We should update the description to "*The listing will start from bucket after the startBucket.*"

HDDS-2721.title: Allow wrapping list of ByteBuffers with ChunkBuffer
HDDS-2721.description: {{ChunkBuffer}} is a useful abstraction over {{ByteBuffer}} to hide whether it's backed by a single {{ByteBuffer}} or multiple ones ({{IncrementalChunkBuffer}}).  However, {{IncrementalChunkBuffer}} allocates its own {{ByteBuffer}} instances and only works with uniform buffer sizes.  The goal of this task is to allow wrapping an existing  {{List<ByteBuffer>}} in {{ChunkBuffer}}.
